rules.name: Charge voltage derived from the declared chemistry
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: charge_voltage == cells * per_cell (+/- tolerance); tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: Thermistor at the cell feeding the charger/BMS
Cell protection present and independent of the charger
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: one of the protection families in the component list; tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: Boost output short-circuit path acknowledged (disconnect switch or accepted)
No copper in the antenna keep-out on any layer
No copper across the isolation barrier
Continuous ground plane; stitching vias near fast signals
No unconnected copper islands
Thermal relief only where hand-soldered; solid on power pads
Thermal via array under exposed pads
Zone clearance to other nets from the profile, never a literal
Inductor saturation current above the peak inductor current
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: Isat >= Iout*(1+ripple/2)*1.2 (buck) or Iin-based (boost); tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: Input voltage range inside the converter IC rating
Electrical clearance from working voltage (IPC-2221B Table 6-1)
rules.verification_method: DesignProfile.derive_clearance_mil -> desk.ipc.required_spacing_mil; written to DSN net classes; tests/test_hardware_reference_values.py
rules.rationale: Table values are transcribed, not yet verified against the standard text (ipc.verified_against_standard=False).

rules.name: Creepage from working voltage, pollution degree and material group (IEC 60664-1 Table F.4)
rules.verification_method: desk.ipc.creepage_mm; max(clearance, creepage, fabricator minimum) becomes the net-pair spacing; tests/test_ipc_models.py
rules.rationale: Human review required because the table transcription is unverified against the IEC text.

rules.name: Voltage drop on power paths within budget
Component voltage/current ratings exceed applied stress with margin
rules.verification_method: Not evaluated by DESK: ratings are not in the BOM model yet (component intelligence roadmap)

rules.name: Unknown electrical inputs fail closed
rules.verification_method: DesignProfile.validate_electrical_inputs lists undeclared rails; RoutingPlan.blocking_issues stops tools/route.py; tests/test_profile_hardening.py
rules.rationale: No assumed value may replace a missing engineering input.

rules.name: Via ampacity and parallel via count
rules.verification_method: desk.ipc.via_current_a / vias_required; reported by tools/route.py; not yet enforced in DSN (router places vias freely)
rules.rationale: The engine computes the count; the autorouter does not yet honour it, so the rule is advisory.

rules.name: Trace width from declared current (IPC-2221)
rules.verification_method: tools/route.py sizes every net from DesignProfile.derive_trace_width_mil; tests/test_ipc_models.py, tests/test_hardware_reference_values.py
rules.rationale: A power net sized without its current is a guess; DESK refuses (unknown_current_policy=fail).

rules.name: ESD protection on every externally accessible signal
Input filter footprints when the product is EMC tested
Hot-loop area minimised and recorded
Switching harmonics out of the radio band
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: n*fsw within the RF band +/- 5 % flagged; tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: Surge/burst protection at every field terminal
Matching network and band plan per region
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: declared frequency inside the region's band; tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: Every mains/HV net declared in voltage_rails before any spacing is derived
rules.verification_method: DesignProfile.get_net_voltage_status flags HV-looking nets without a declared voltage; derive_clearance_mil raises

rules.name: Fuse first after the mains connector; MOV after the fuse
rules.verification_method: Deterministic family presence; order is a schematic review item

rules.name: Insulation grade (basic/double/reinforced) declared for the barrier
rules.verification_method: Deterministic presence check; the creepage doubles for reinforced (applied by desk.profile.creepage parameters)

rules.name: Discharge resistor across X capacitors
3.3 V rail delivers the radio TX peak with headroom
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: declared 3V3 current >= TX peak * 1.2; tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: Strapping/boot pins at the documented level at reset
rules.verification_method: tools/lint.py checks that every pin is mapped or nc; strap levels are a spec qa[] entry
rules.rationale: Lint enforces mapping; the level itself is a datasheet-sourced qa entry.

rules.name: USB D+/D- as a 90 ohm pair with ESD at the connector
Conformal coating changes the clearance condition (B4)
rules.verification_method: clearance_condition must be B4 when coated; checked by the profile compiler

rules.name: Via drill and annular ring within the fabricator capability
Copper setback from the board edge
Trace width and clearance at or above the fabricator minimum
rules.verification_method: ManufacturerProfile floors applied in width/clearance derivation; DRC with the fabricator rule set

rules.name: Slot the board where creepage cannot be met in the barrier
Over-current trip wired from the sense amplifier to the driver fault input
Peak phase current declared; devices and copper rated with margin
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: FET rating >= peak * 1.3; copper via ELEC-WIDTH-001 on the peak; tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: Antenna at the board edge with the datasheet keep-out
rules.verification_method: Keep-out must be declared in placement.json; then enforced as PLACE-KEEPOUT-011
rules.rationale: The keep-out value itself comes from the antenna datasheet (human input).

rules.name: Decoupling capacitor within 2 mm of the supply pin
rules.verification_method: desk.placement_refine PlacementRefiner decoupling proximity objective; tests/test_dense_intelligence.py

rules.name: Feedback network at the FB pin, away from the switch node and inductor
Converter hot loop minimal: Cin, switches and rectifier adjacent
rules.verification_method: Placement refiner hard rules (group proximity); loop area itself is not measured yet
rules.rationale: Grouping enforced; loop area reported only.

rules.name: Only isolating components bridge the isolation barrier
rules.verification_method: Barrier declared as a keep-out polygon on all layers; pads inside it fail preflight

rules.name: Keep-outs (antenna, barrier, mechanical) are empty on every layer
rules.verification_method: desk.placement.check and routing preflight pads_inside_keepouts; tests/test_route_preflight.py, tests/test_placement.py

rules.name: Current-sense resistor with Kelvin pads adjacent to its amplifier
Heat-sensitive parts away from dissipating parts
Crystal and load capacitors within 5 mm of the oscillator pins
High-current routing constraint: polygons, parallel vias, Kelvin sense
Differential pairs at the interface impedance with matched length
rules.verification_method: DiffPairProfile carried into DSN net classes (width/spacing); length matching and impedance are not verified by DESK (router.DiffPairVerification not wired)
rules.rationale: Geometry is applied; the result is not verified, so advisory until DiffPairVerification is wired into quality gates.

rules.name: Encoder/hall signals routed away from phase copper and filtered
Gate drive loops short with return on the adjacent layer
Guard rings on high-impedance analog nodes
No vias or signals inside the isolation barrier
rules.verification_method: Route keep-outs passed to Freerouting as keepout areas; verified by preflight

rules.name: Sense traces from the inner pad edges; no current in sense traces
Nets above 3 A as polygons sized by IPC-2221
Route in priority order: diff pairs/RF, high-current, critical, power, signal
rules.verification_method: RoutingPriorityScheduler stages + density priority order -> Freerouting net classes; tests/test_routing_priority.py

rules.name: Return path continuity: no high-speed or switching nets across plane splits
RF feed as a 50 ohm line with ground fence and no vias
rules.verification_method: RFProfile width/ground clearance applied as net-class width and clearance; via prohibition not enforced by Freerouting

rules.name: Switch node short, wide, single layer; never under feedback
Copper area per watt from the device datasheet
Continuous dissipators derated to 60-70 % of rating
Junction temperature below the datasheet limit at max ambient
rules.verification_method: Not computed by DESK (no per-device dissipation model); recorded in REQUIREMENTS.md section 6

rules.name: CC pull-down/up configuration matches the port role
rules.verification_method: Deterministic: sink needs Rd 5.1 k on both CC; source needs Rp; tests/test_rule_engine.py

rules.name: VBUS components rated for the maximum negotiated voltage
